available: Native separate-edge site spectra (100 photon energies and 100 intensities each)
Per-record periodic structures and absorbing indices
not_released: Local-environment labels used for the plotted comparisons
Historical figure-generation code or machine-learning splits/predictions
scope: All native Ti,V,Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni,Cu absorber records, including orphan edges, negative values and identifier inconsistencies. The source selection does not use target labels.

ground_truth.Q1: Original structures, site spectra and independently reconstructed crystallographic populations support checks of completeness and physically weighted responses. No author-released averaged spectrum is claimed as an external target.
ground_truth.Q2: Independent periodic geometry and native numerical edge data verify submitted observations. Conditional associations and interpretation are scientific judgments; there is no mandated sign or strength.
ground_truth.Q3: Reference environments are derived independently from native structures under declared definitions, and metrics are recomputed from predictions with composition-aware partition checks. There is no historical model-performance target.

source_code.role: Paper-era package snapshot inspected to clarify processing conventions, not asserted to be the exact historical authors commit. No separate analysis code accompanies the Figshare archive.
findings: site_weighted_spectrum infers crystallographic multiplicities and uses cubic interpolation on the intersection of native energy support.
L23 stitching evaluates on L3 support and extrapolates L2 cubic values, clipping negative extrapolated L2 contributions. This extrapolation can affect peak balance.

The candidate must disclose its own interpolation and finite-support conventions; different defensible conventions are not automatically wrong. No new FEFF executable or Materials Project API key is required.

identity_caution.finding: The mp-id field aliases two distinct structures: mp-12905 names have14 sites, mvc-12905 names have12 sites. Native lines are retained; material identity must be checked against geometry.
identity_caution.other_metadata_variants: Six additional materials have differing structure dictionaries despite identical lattice/fractional coordinates; optional site properties are not physical geometry differences.

verification_meaning: Numerical integrity, source truth and separate scientific assessment. Worked outputs are illustrative, not exact answer keys for unrestricted analyses. Difficulty has not been empirically calibrated.
code_link_caveat: The review entry Open code link points to an inspected open-source dependency tag; it is not a separately released analysis repository or a claim to the authors exact commit.
